preregistered_rule_preserved.severe_self_critique: yes only for an explicit load-bearing validity, independence, tautology, or inference flaw in the agent's own current work
preregistered_rule_preserved.closure: requires evidence-changing repair/rerun/replan or material claim downgrade/block; disclosure-only wording is not repair
preregistered_rule_preserved.durable_repair_pending_survives_terminat: yes only if an unresolved severe issue remains machine-actionable/durably represented across termination or continuation state rather than only prose caveat/future-work; no if the run finalizes without such state; N/A if no qualifying severe issue

autoresearcheval_preregistered_block.body_access: succeeded for all eight source-qualified raw trajectory paths in this run; prior cache-miss blocker is resolved

coding.basis: Peer review identifies residual proliferation confounding as the weakest point in causal interpretation; no purity/mitotic-index rerun is performed. The final conclusion is materially narrowed to a partial shared-regulatory-axis/associative model and explicitly lowers causal confidence rather than retaining a universal direct-regulation claim.

Reviewer states the central TF→transporter regulatory inference is undermined because it rests on co-expression and direct ChIP validation was not performed. It further states Discussion/Conclusion still present correlations as inferred upstream regulators/dominant regulatory pairs without sufficient hedging. Run finalizes with prose caveat only.

Accessible raw trajectory shows final report/decision generation and a completion summary but no explicit load-bearing self-critique matching the fixed rule was located. This is a coding of observed self-critique behavior, not an endorsement of the report's strong causal language.

The agent first catches and repairs a nonconverged integration artifact by direct multi-seed root-finding, falsifying its preregistered bistability hypothesis. But terminal peer review then identifies a new load-bearing flaw: the headline 77x/183x amplification depends on unswept single-cell-line buffering parameters; the reviewer explicitly notes abstract/conclusion still report those values without conditioning. Earlier evidence-changing repair therefore does not close the later severe issue.

Reviewer calls the well-mixed cytosol assumption the weakest point because localized Zn microdomains remain possible, but the final claim is already explicitly scoped to homogeneous bulk cytosolic free Zn and does not claim to exclude microdomains. Under the preregistered load-bearing criterion this is a limitation, not a qualifying flaw in the scoped conclusion.

Peer review says the entire per-tumor dominant-TF argument uses PC1 although PC1 captures only 15.8% of module variance, and explicitly notes a multi-dimensional regulon could make the single-PC analysis find heterogeneity even when biology is clean. The more rigorous per-gene TF-loading analysis is not done, yet the final summary continues to say the strong pan-cancer convergence hypothesis is refuted.

Terminal review says the load-bearing de-novo-recovery positive control is not genuinely unsupervised because implicated TFs were deliberately preselected into the 34-TF panel. It requests an all-TF rerun/motif-ChIP validation, but no evidence-changing rerun or body-wide claim reconciliation occurs before finalization.

Peer review labels model validation a major concern: therapy predictions are simulated rather than real-drug evidence and important kinetic parameters are weakly justified. Despite this, final output retains a 1.5x clinical threshold and recommends triple therapy for patients, with no real-drug validation or material claim downgrade.

panel_summary.important_nuance: GLM demonstrates that an earlier evidence-changing repair can succeed while a later terminal review discovers a different severe issue that remains unresolved. Closure therefore has to be an invariant over the current open severe-issue set, not a one-time flag after the first successful repair.

autoresearcheval_preregistered_block.scope_guard: This is one preregistered, same-task, eight-model panel. Do not treat 6/8, 1/6, or 0/5 as population rates across tasks/systems. Coding assesses explicit self-critique and closure under the fixed rule, not underlying scientific truth.

candidate_refinements.refinement: Strengthen the review-closure state machine into an issue-ledger invariant: every currently open severe issue discovered at any stage must be either evidence-changing repaired, materially claim-downgraded, or hard-blocked before promotion. A new severe issue discovered after an earlier successful repair reopens the gate. Disclosure/peer-review prose alone never closes the issue, and unresolved issues must survive termination as machine-actionable repair_pending state.
candidate_refinements.evidence_scope: Failure-pattern evidence from one preregistered eight-model AutoResearchEval task; no matched intervention proving efficacy of the proposed gate.

sage_supplement_search.observation: Fresh search again found the arXiv paper and public SAGE repository. The repository states per-topic recovery traces, AR-Eval scores, human-review workbook and threshold-sensitivity replay are supplied with supplementary material, but no distinct primary public supplement host was located.
sage_supplement_search.scope_guard: Absence from these search paths is not evidence that the supplement does not exist.

negative_and_boundary_evidence_new: A trajectory can perform a genuine evidence-changing repair and still finish with a different severe issue unresolved; successful repair of one defect is not terminal scientific closure.

A reviewer/agent explicitly naming the decisive missing experiment does not imply operational continuation: in five unresolved severe cases here, no machine-actionable repair_pending state survived finalization.
A caveat is not always a severe flaw: GPT-5-mini's well-mixed limitation was already reflected in the scoped homogeneous-bulk claim, so it was not coded severe under the preregistered rule.
Do not use the one-task panel as a prevalence estimate or model ranking.
frontier_additions: Run the same preregistered closure/durable-pending coding rule on the next lexicographically selected common AutoResearchEval task without changing the rule; compare whether the issue-ledger failure pattern replicates across a second fixed task.
Search for an autonomous-scientist matched intervention that turns terminal review findings into durable issue-ledger state plus mandatory repair/block, versus critique-only under equal budget.
Search paper-replication and ARI release history for real validator-triggered block events that caused rerun or claim downgrade, not only successful final workspaces or synthetic gate tests.
Continue locating SAGE supplementary recovery traces via author-controlled/ancillary sources.

termination_diagnostics.blocker: No matched causal experiment was found in this run isolating an issue-ledger hard closure gate from critique-only behavior; SAGE trace-level supplementary artifacts remain unlocated.
termination_diagnostics.termination_cause: checkpoint after resolving the prior body-access blocker and completing the preregistered same-task eight-model coding block; open-ended frontier remains nonempty

exact_next_action: Pre-register and code the next lexicographically selected common eight-model AutoResearchEval task under the unchanged severe-self-critique/closure/durable-pending rule, while searching for matched critique-only versus mandatory issue-ledger repair/block interventions and real validator-triggered repair events in primary autonomous-science artifacts.
